newsitem.title: UK: Britain's P&O orders 200 mln stg superliner.
newsitem.headline: Britain's P&O orders 200 mln stg superliner.

text.p: Britain's Peninsular and Oriental Steam Navigation Co said on Thursday it had placed an order for a 76,000-ton superliner that would cost 200 million stg.
The superliner, a sister ship to the line's flagship Oriana, will be built at the Meyer Werft shipyard in Germany, P&O said in a statement.
The new ship, to be delivered for service in the spring of 2000, will carry more than 1,800 passengers on a wide range of global cruises from Britain.
The cruise ship will include five decks of cabins with private balconies, a business centre and a retractable dome over the midships swimming pool.
The order followed news last month that P&O's Princess Cruises unit planned to introduce a 77,000-ton superliner in late 1999 costing $300 million. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
